name: @trajectonomics/auth
description: The auth Worker at auth.trajectonomics.com: Better Auth accounts, social sign-in, passkeys, device authorization and Ed25519 JWTs for the platform. Never published to npm.

scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun e2e/prepare.ts && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: astro sync && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && astro check && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.check: bun ../../tooling/scripts/run-parallel.ts "bun run lint" "bun run typecheck" "bun run test" && bun ../../tooling/scripts/build-unless-turbo.ts
